urge.sentenceEn: USPS urges those without standing addresses to file change-of-address forms with their new location.
urge.translationZh: 美国邮政局敦促那些没有固定地址的人提交地址变更表格，注明他们的新住址。

urge.sentenceEn: What did the head of road policing urge drivers to do?
urge.translationZh: 道路警务负责人敦促司机做什么？

urge.sentenceEn: First Minister Nicola Sturgeon urged ScottishPower to reduce carbon emissions.
urge.translationZh: 首席大臣尼古拉·斯特金敦促苏格兰电力公司减少碳排放。

urgent.sentenceEn: Apart from the urgent task of providing more healthy nutrients to those who increasingly can't afford them, publicly accessible fruit and vegetable gardens connect what we eat to where it comes from—the means of production, if you will.
urgent.translationZh: 除了向越来越多买不起健康食品的人提供更多健康营养这一紧迫任务外，公共果蔬园还将我们的食物与其来源——也就是生产方式（如果你愿意这么说的话）——联系起来。
urgent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

urgent.sentenceEn: Director of Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation Chris Murray described it as an " urgent call to action."
urgent.translationZh: 健康指标与评估研究所所长克里斯·默里称其为一个“亟待采取行动的呼吁”。
urgent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

urgent.sentenceEn: It is urgent that schools teach kids how to verify online information.
urgent.translationZh: 学校亟需教会孩子们如何验证网络信息。

urgent.sentenceEn: It is urgent to provide an ideal habitat for them to thrive.
urgent.translationZh: 为它们提供一个理想的栖息环境以促进其繁衍生息，已成为当务之急。

uniform.sentenceEn: Nearly all British schools have uniforms .
uniform.translationZh: 几乎所有的英国学校都要求穿校服。
uniform.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

uniform.sentenceEn: The price of school uniforms can spark panic among families struggling with the high cost of living.
uniform.translationZh: 校服的价格可能会让那些在高昂生活成本中挣扎的家庭感到恐慌。
uniform.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

uniform.sentenceEn: According to the new rules, students of Taverham are required to wear smart black shoes appropriate for the workplace, Harris held that strengthened rules around school uniforms improved student outcomes and behavior.
uniform.translationZh: 根据新规定，塔弗姆学校的学生必须穿着适合职场的正式黑色皮鞋。哈里斯认为，加强校服管理规定能够改善学生的学习成绩和行为表现。
uniform.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

uniform.sentenceEn: May said that the school's uniform policy showed the lack of regard for parents dealing with the high cost of living.
uniform.translationZh: 梅表示，学校的校服政策反映出其对正面临高生活成本压力的家长缺乏关注。
uniform.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

uniform.sentenceEn: What did the headteacher think of the school's new uniform rules?
uniform.translationZh: 校长对学校新的校服规定有什么看法？

uniform.sentenceEn: They are relatively uniform in color and design.
uniform.translationZh: 它们在颜色和设计上相对统一。

union.sentenceEn: The idea from the African Union has been modeled on the EU Schengen free movement deal.
union.translationZh: 非洲联盟的这一构想效仿了欧盟申根自由流动协议。
union.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

union.sentenceEn: The African Union , which represents 54 states, wants to abolish the requirement of a visa for Africans visiting other African countries.
union.translationZh: 代表54个成员国的非洲联盟希望取消非洲人前往其他非洲国家所需的签证要求。
union.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第10句

union.sentenceEn: The American Civil Liberties Union has stated that digital assistants create a threat to privacy from hackers.
union.translationZh: 美国公民自由联盟指出，数字助手带来了黑客入侵隐私的威胁。

union.sentenceEn: In May, the American Civil Liberties Union (ACLU) and Outten & Golden LLP announced a historic class-action $5m settlement with JPMorgan Chase on behalf of male employees who claim they were illegally denied access to paid parental leave.
union.translationZh: 今年5月，美国公民自由联盟（ACLU）与Outten & Golden律师事务所代表那些声称被非法剥夺带薪育儿假权利的男性员工，宣布与摩根大通达成一项历史性的集体诉讼和解协议，金额达500万美元。

union.sentenceEn: Romania's wetlands are coming back to life thanks to help from local communities, the World Wildlife Fund, and funding from the European Union .
union.translationZh: 在当地社区、世界野生动物基金会的帮助以及欧盟的资助下，罗马尼亚的湿地正在恢复生机。
union.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

union.sentenceEn: She is a trade union representative.

undertake.sentenceEn: The business perspective offers a different view: multitasking is understood as the ability to adapt to all types of environment within a company and effectively undertake different activities within a set time frame.
undertake.translationZh: 从商业角度来看则有所不同：多任务处理被理解为能够适应公司内的各种环境，并在规定时间内有效开展不同活动的能力。
undertake.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

undertake.sentenceEn: Older people who watch more television are also less likely to undertake activities known to preserve mental functioning such as reading, or interactive screen-based pursuits such as using the Internet or playing video games.
undertake.translationZh: 看电视较多的老年人也不太可能从事已知有助于保持心智功能的活动，如阅读，或基于屏幕的互动性消遣活动，如使用互联网或玩电子游戏。
undertake.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

undertake.sentenceEn: If you're concerned that the amount of television you're watching could have a negative impact on your health, you should limit the amount of TV you watch each day and undertake some healthy hobbies.
undertake.translationZh: 如果你担心看电视的时长可能对健康产生负面影响，就应该限制每天的观看时间，并培养一些有益健康的爱好。
undertake.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第8句

undertake.sentenceEn: This argument has its critics, but considering the way chores are undertaken around the world may change people's thinking.
undertake.translationZh: 这种观点虽有批评者，但了解世界各地分担家务的方式可能会改变人们的想法。
undertake.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

undertake.sentenceEn: UNESCO urged the Italian government to undertake its responsibility to protect Venice.
undertake.translationZh: 联合国教科文组织敦促意大利政府履行其保护威尼斯的责任。

undertake.sentenceEn: They enable people to undertake massive tasks.
undertake.translationZh: 它们使人们能够承担艰巨的任务。

unemployment.sentenceEn: Ageism and long-term unemployment are most damaging for those in the second half of their careers.
unemployment.translationZh: 对于处于职业生涯后半程的人来说，年龄歧视和长期失业的影响最为严重。

unemployment.sentenceEn: What Keynes predicted was a very optimistic version of what economists call technological unemployment .
unemployment.translationZh: 凯恩斯所预测的，是经济学家所谓的技术性失业的一种非常乐观的版本。

unemployment.sentenceEn: In Keynes's vision, the resulting unemployment would be distributed more or less evenly across society in the form of increased leisure.
unemployment.translationZh: 在凯恩斯的构想中，由此产生的失业问题将以增加闲暇时间的形式或多或少均匀地分布于整个社会。

unemployment.sentenceEn: "Even when unemployment results from the introduction of new technologies, people still judge it in a social context," says Christoph Fuchs, one of the authors of the study.
unemployment.translationZh: 该研究的作者之一克里斯托夫·富克斯表示：“即使失业是由新技术的引入造成的，人们仍然会在社会背景下对其进行评判。”
unemployment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

unemployment.sentenceEn: People over 45 stimulated by training suffer shorter periods of unemployment , get more job offers and have greater satisfaction in them.
unemployment.translationZh: 45岁以上的人群在接受培训激励后，失业时间更短，获得的就业机会更多，且职业满意度也更高。

unemployment.sentenceEn: Unemployment rates are rising year after year.

unexpected.sentenceEn: When snowy weather arrives in the US, it means the chance of school children benefiting from the long-standing tradition of the "snow day", when schools are forced to close and students get an unexpected day off.
unexpected.translationZh: 当美国迎来降雪天气时，这意味着学龄儿童有机会享受由来已久的“雪天”传统——学校被迫停课，学生们意外获得一天假期。

unexpected.sentenceEn: The dog owner's beloved 10-year-old dog named Buddy took an unexpected 16-hour flight to Tokyo following a mix-up by the airline.
unexpected.translationZh: 这只名叫Buddy的10岁爱犬因航空公司的失误，意外踏上了长达16小时飞往东京的旅程。
unexpected.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

unexpected.sentenceEn: And that's not exactly an unexpected question.
unexpected.translationZh: 而且这也不是什么出人意料的问题。

unexpected.sentenceEn: Indeed, people tend to dip in and out of poverty, perhaps due to unexpected obstacles like losing a job, or when hours of a low-wage job fluctuate.
unexpected.translationZh: 事实上，人们常常陷入贫困又脱离贫困，这可能是由于失业等意外困境，或是因为低薪工作的工时不稳定。

unexpected.sentenceEn: Barley was an unexpected find: the crop was domesticated in Western Eurasia and didn't become a staple food in central China until about 2,000 years ago, according to the researchers.
unexpected.translationZh: 研究人员表示，大麦的发现出乎意料：这种作物最初在欧亚大陆西部被驯化，直到约2000年前才成为中国中部地区的主食。
unexpected.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第10句

uncomfortable.sentenceEn: It may be an uncomfortable process, but good leaders and healthy teams recognize that productive and healthy conflict is an important part of how they function.
uncomfortable.translationZh: 这可能是一个令人不适的过程，但优秀的领导者和健康的团队都明白，富有成效的良性冲突是他们运作方式中重要的组成部分。
uncomfortable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

uncomfortable.sentenceEn: Increasingly, we are uncomfortable , annoyed, disgusted, scared or unaware.
uncomfortable.translationZh: 我们（洛杉矶居民）的感受正逐渐变成不安、恼怒、厌恶、恐惧，或是对此视而不见。
uncomfortable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

uncomfortable.sentenceEn: A mere acquaintance entering our intimate space makes us uncomfortable .
uncomfortable.translationZh: 仅仅是一个泛泛之交进入我们的私密空间就会让我们感到不适。
uncomfortable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

uncomfortable.sentenceEn: Another worker said the lack of protection at the store made her feel uncomfortable at work.
uncomfortable.translationZh: 另一名员工表示，店内缺乏保护措施让她在工作时感到不安。
uncomfortable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

uncomfortable.sentenceEn: Why does the woman feel uncomfortable about sending Jake to Lakeview School?
uncomfortable.translationZh: 为什么这位女士对于把杰克送到湖景学校感到不安？
这会让我们感到不舒服。

undergo.sentenceEn: This characteristic is particularly apparent in a new study, focusing on people who underwent a hemispherectomy, a surgical procedure in which half of the brain is removed to treat illness.
undergo.translationZh: 这一特征在一项新研究中尤为明显，该研究关注接受了半球切除术的人群——这是一种通过切除大脑半球来治疗疾病的外科手术。
undergo.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

undergo.sentenceEn: As many office workers adapt to remote work, cities may undergo fundamental change if offices remain under-utilized.
undergo.translationZh: 随着众多办公室职员适应远程工作，如果办公楼持续利用率低下，城市可能会发生根本性变化。
undergo.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

undergo.sentenceEn: This means that some wells may even need to undergo desalination after extraction, thus increasing the cost.
undergo.translationZh: 这意味着有些井甚至在抽水后还需要进行脱盐处理，从而增加了成本。
undergo.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

undergo.sentenceEn: He is expected to undergo a knee operation.
undergo.translationZh: 他预计要接受膝盖手术。

unhealthy.sentenceEn: The teens chose healthy snacks and drinks (such as fruit or water) more often over unhealthy options (like biscuits and soda).
unhealthy.translationZh: 比起饼干和汽水等不健康食品，这些青少年更常选择水果或水等健康零食和饮料。
unhealthy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第5句

unhealthy.sentenceEn: This in turn could reduce consumption of unhealthy , high-calorie processed meals.
unhealthy.translationZh: 这反过来又可能减少不健康、高热量加工食品的消费。
unhealthy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第6句

unhealthy.sentenceEn: "Despite our scientific progress," she writes, "Americans are remarkably unhealthy . In 2016, the United States ranked forty-third in the world for life expectancy. It is also by far the world's most expensive place to get sick."
unhealthy.translationZh: 她在书中写道：“尽管我们的科学取得了进步，但美国人的健康状况却糟糕得惊人。2016年，美国的人均预期寿命在全球排名第43位。这里同时也是世界上医疗费用最为昂贵的地方。”

unhealthy.sentenceEn: Are unhealthy diets really the result of poor choices, limited food skills and knowledge?
unhealthy.translationZh: 不健康的饮食真的是由于选择不当、烹饪技能有限和知识匮乏造成的吗？
unhealthy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

unhealthy.sentenceEn: Trying to live up to the images of "perfect" models and movie heroes has a dark side: anxiety and depression, as well as unhealthy strategies for weight loss or muscle gain.
unhealthy.translationZh: 试图达到"完美"模特和电影英雄的形象标准存在阴暗面：焦虑与抑郁，以及不健康的减肥或增肌策略。
unhealthy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

unhealthy.sentenceEn: People with unhealthy eating habits are likely to die sooner.
unhealthy.translationZh: 饮食习惯不健康的人可能会较早死亡。

universal.sentenceEn: While only a small portion of the world's languages are anumeric or nearly anumeric, they demonstrate that number words are not a human universal .
universal.translationZh: 虽然世界上只有一小部分语言属于无数字语言或近乎无数字语言，但它们证明了数字词汇并非人类共通的语言现象。

universal.sentenceEn: There's a good explanation for the phenomenon in the book The Formula: The Universal Laws of Success by Albert Laszlo Barabasi.
universal.translationZh: 阿尔伯特·拉斯洛·巴拉巴西在其著作《公式：成功的普遍法则》中对这一现象做出了很好的解释。

universal.sentenceEn: Share your observations about the world around you—interesting stories you heard or things you noticed—and you may be surprised by the universal connection they inspire.
universal.translationZh: 分享你对周遭世界的观察——你听到的有趣故事或注意到的事物——你可能会惊讶于它们所激发的普遍共鸣。

universal.sentenceEn: While cheek-kissing for Latin Americans is also a universal greeting form, it does not require such a high degree of relational closeness.
universal.translationZh: 虽然亲吻脸颊对拉丁美洲人来说也是一种普遍的问候方式，但它并不要求双方的关系达到如此高的亲密程度。
universal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

universal.sentenceEn: The intention to put a home-cooked meal on the table was pretty much universal .
universal.translationZh: 为家人准备一顿家常便饭的想法几乎是每个家庭的共识。

universal.sentenceEn: It's expected to raise $410 million over the next five years, most of which will go toward funding a universal prekindergarten program for the city.
universal.translationZh: 预计未来五年内，这项税收将筹集4.1亿美元，其中大部分资金将用于为该市普及学前教育项目提供资金支持。
universal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

upper.sentenceEn: The status of the upper classes was threatened; fashion was a tool to preserve it.
upper.translationZh: 上层阶级的地位受到了威胁；时尚成为他们维系地位的工具。
upper.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

upper.sentenceEn: Should Americans accept a system in which the middle and upper classes enjoy a luxurious lifestyle, using the low-wage labor of others?
upper.translationZh: 美国人是否应该接受这样一种体制：中上层阶级享受奢华生活方式，却要依赖他人的低薪劳动？
upper.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

upper.sentenceEn: Contrary to some research that has found an upper limit to the amount of exercise that is healthy, the researchers found that there was seemingly no limit to the longevity(长寿) benefits of exercise.
upper.translationZh: 一些研究发现健康锻炼量存在上限，但与此相反，研究人员发现锻炼对长寿的益处似乎没有上限。
upper.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

upper.sentenceEn: As such, different populations of killer whales have had to learn different hunting techniques in order to gain the upper hand over their local prey(猎物).
upper.translationZh: 正因如此，不同种群的虎鲸必须学会不同的捕猎技巧，才能在捕猎本地猎物时占据优势。
upper.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

upper.sentenceEn: Now known as "New York's shared space for art and play," the island, which lies between Manhattan and Brooklyn in Upper New York Bay, is closed to cars but open to summer tourists who flock for festivals, picnics, adventures, as well as these "legal graffiti(涂鸦)" sessions.
upper.translationZh: 如今，这座位于上纽约湾、地处曼哈顿与布鲁克林之间的岛屿被誉为"纽约艺术与休闲共享空间"。该岛禁止机动车通行，但对夏季游客开放，他们纷纷前来参加节庆活动、野餐、探险，以及这些"合法涂鸦"活动。
upper.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

upper.sentenceEn: It is a place in Upper New York Bay formerly used for exiles.
upper.translationZh: 这是上纽约湾的一个地方，以前用于流放。

unclear.sentenceEn: It's unclear why the Queen built the zoo, but it might have been to show off her wealth and power.
unclear.translationZh: 目前尚不清楚女王为何修建这座动物园，但这可能是为了炫耀她的财富和权力。
unclear.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

unclear.sentenceEn: It was unclear who the owner was.
unclear.translationZh: 目前尚不清楚这条蛇的主人是谁。
unclear.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

unclear.sentenceEn: The police officer interviewed told news reporters the snake didn't belong to the man and it was unclear how it got into the apartment.
unclear.translationZh: 接受采访的警官告诉新闻记者，这条蛇不属于该男子，目前尚不清楚它是如何进入公寓的。
unclear.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

unclear.sentenceEn: It was unclear where the rest of the group was from, but they were most likely traveling together.
unclear.translationZh: 目前尚不清楚该团体其他成员来自哪里，但他们很可能是一起旅行的。
unclear.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

unclear.sentenceEn: It is unclear whether the new owners have the power to ban tourists from the island.
unclear.translationZh: 目前尚不清楚新业主是否有权禁止游客进入该岛。
unclear.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

unclear.sentenceEn: They are often unclear about the career goals to reach.
unclear.translationZh: 她们往往不清楚自己要达成的职业目标。

undergraduate.sentenceEn: The state attracts more undergraduate students than it sends to colleges out of state.
undergraduate.translationZh: 该州吸引的本科生多于其送往州外大学的学生。
undergraduate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

undergraduate.sentenceEn: It was a world apart from her undergraduate days at the University of California-Berkeley majoring in political science.
undergraduate.translationZh: 这与她在加州大学伯克利分校攻读政治学本科的日子截然不同。

undergraduate.sentenceEn: This fall, thousands of college students from across the country will begin their undergraduate studies at colleges around the nation.
undergraduate.translationZh: 今年秋季，全国各地成千上万的大学生将开始他们在全国各地高校的本科学习。

undergraduate.sentenceEn: Although women make up the majority of undergraduates in our universities, just under half of academic staff are female.
undergraduate.translationZh: 尽管女性在我们大学的本科生中占大多数，但在学术人员中女性比例还不到一半。
undergraduate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

undergraduate.sentenceEn: In the past decade, we have seen a considerable increase in England in the number of women accepted on to full-time undergraduate degrees in science, technology, engineering and maths (Stem subjects).
undergraduate.translationZh: 在过去十年中，我们看到英格兰攻读科学、技术、工程和数学（Stem学科）全日制本科学位的女性人数大幅增加。
undergraduate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

undergraduate.sentenceEn: They are harder to meet than those for undergraduates .
undergraduate.translationZh: 研究生毕业要求比本科生毕业要求更难达到。

unlikely.sentenceEn: Posting about luxury purchases and expensive vacations online may help you to persuade others and frighten competitors, but it could also signal to potential friends or future employers that you are unlikely to think about the needs of others.
unlikely.translationZh: 在网上炫耀奢侈品购买和奢华度假经历，或许能帮你说服他人、震慑竞争对手，但也可能向潜在的朋友或未来的雇主传递出你不太会考虑他人需求的信号。
unlikely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

unlikely.sentenceEn: Playing games casually is unlikely to help your career prospects.
unlikely.translationZh: 随性地玩游戏不太可能对你的职业前景有所帮助。

unlikely.sentenceEn: In the new global economy, students who fail to finish the ninth grade with passing grades in college preparatory coursework are very unlikely to graduate on time and go on to get jobs.
unlikely.translationZh: 在新的全球经济环境下，九年级学生如果未能顺利完成大学预科课程并取得及格成绩，就极有可能无法按时毕业，进而影响就业。

unlikely.sentenceEn: If you are on a plane with a sick passenger, you are unlikely to get sick.
unlikely.translationZh: 如果你乘坐的飞机上有生病的乘客，你不太可能会被传染生病。
unlikely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

unlikely.sentenceEn: Students' ability to learn formal writing is unlikely to be affected by texting.
unlikely.translationZh: 学生学习正式写作的能力不太可能受到短信的影响。

unlikely.sentenceEn: They are unlikely to break their career trajectory to raise a family.
unlikely.translationZh: 他们不太可能为了养育家庭而中断自己的职业发展轨迹。

unaware.sentenceEn: With a literacy rate in some parts of Africa at only 22.6%, farmers are often "underpaid for their produce because they might be unaware of the prevailing prices," says Francis Dittoh, a researcher behind Mr Meteo, a speech-based weather information service.
unaware.translationZh: 非洲部分地区的识字率仅为22.6%，农民们常常“因不了解当前市场价格而使农产品被压价”，弗朗西斯·迪托说道。他是基于语音的天气信息服务“气象先生”(Mr Meteo)背后的研究人员。

unaware.sentenceEn: Increasingly, we are uncomfortable, annoyed, disgusted, scared or unaware .
unaware.translationZh: 我们（洛杉矶居民）的感受正逐渐变成不安、恼怒、厌恶、恐惧，或是对此视而不见。
unaware.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

unaware.sentenceEn: The Italian Culture Ministry says it is unaware of any government efforts to pressure UNESCO.
unaware.translationZh: 意大利文化部表示，他们不清楚政府有任何向联合国教科文组织施压的举动。

unaware.sentenceEn: Although Leslie perhaps paints a bit broadly in contending that most of us are unaware of how much we don't know, he's surely right to point out that the problem is growing: "Google can give us the powerful illusion that all questions have definite answers."
unaware.translationZh: 尽管莱斯利声称大多数人都没有意识到自己有多少未知的东西，这种说法或许有些以偏概全，但他指出这个问题正在加剧，这无疑是正确的：“谷歌会给我们一种强烈的错觉，让我们以为所有问题都有确定的答案。”

unaware.sentenceEn: Despite being unaware that there were two types of instruction, teachers reported significant motivational changes in 27% of the children in the growth mind-set workshop as compared with only 9% of students in the control group.
unaware.translationZh: 尽管教师们并不知道存在两种不同类型的教学方式，但他们报告称，成长型思维模式 workshops 中的孩子有27%出现了显著的学习动机变化，而对照组中这一比例仅为9%。

unaware.sentenceEn: Over half of the students interviewed were unaware they were cheating.
unaware.translationZh: 超过一半的受访学生并未意识到自己在作弊。
